title: AI Media 3/5 - conditional missing components acquisition
description: This is the only consent-gated chapter. Reuse everything found in discovery. If models are missing, download only the minimum image/video/audio/Polish-voice components, keeping caches and new assets on D:. No LLM models are moved from their existing D: location.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';& 'C:/3EN-Agent/ai-media-local-v1.ps1' -Phase Acquire -Root 'D:/AI-Media';$s=Get-Content 'D:/AI-Media/state/state.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not $s.comfyUI){throw 'ComfyUI was not detected; separate app decision required'};$cp=Join-Path $s.comfyUI 'models/checkpoints';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cp|Out-Null;$audio=Join-Path $cp 'stable-audio-open-1.0.safetensors';if(-not(Test-Path $audio)){Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/stable-audio-open-1.0_repackaged/resolve/main/stable-audio-open-1.0.safetensors?download=true' -OutFile ($audio+'.partial');if((Get-Item ($audio+'.partial')).Length -lt 4000000000){throw 'Stable Audio download incomplete'};Move-Item ($audio+'.partial') $audio -Force};$piperRoot='D:/AI-Media/apps/piper';$piperExe=Join-Path $piperRoot 'piper/piper.exe';if(-not(Test-Path $piperExe)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $piperRoot|Out-Null;$zip=Join-Path $piperRoot 'piper.zip';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/rhasspy/piper/releases/download/2023.11.14-2/piper_windows_amd64.zip' -OutFile $zip;Expand-Archive $zip -DestinationPath $piperRoot -Force;Remove-Item $zip -Force};$vr='D:/AI-Media/models/voice/pl_PL-gosia-medium';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $vr|Out-Null;$onnx=Join-Path $vr 'pl_PL-gosia-medium.onnx';$cfg=$onnx+'.json';if(-not(Test-Path $onnx)){Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/pl/pl_PL/gosia/medium/pl_PL-gosia-medium.onnx?download=true' -OutFile $onnx};if(-not(Test-Path $cfg)){Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/pl/pl_PL/gosia/medium/pl_PL-gosia-medium.onnx.json?download=true' -OutFile $cfg};[ordered]@{audioModel=$audio;piper=$piperExe;voiceModel=$onnx}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content 'D:/AI-Media/state/media-addons.json' -Encoding UTF8;Write-Host 'AI_MEDIA_ACQUIRE=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'No destructive rollback: downloaded assets are isolated under D:/AI-Media or existing ComfyUI model folders; existing applications/models remain untouched.'
